# Oral-B Service Portal

> Global customer support hub for Oral-B electric toothbrushes, offering replacement parts, product registration, and regional service across 15+ countries in multiple languages.

The Oral-B Service Portal provides localized support for customers worldwide, enabling product registration for warranty benefits, access to genuine replacement parts and accessories, and region-specific customer service resources. The platform operates in multiple languages including Spanish, Portuguese, German, Romanian, Croatian, and English.

## Key Topics

- Oral-B electric toothbrushes
- Product registration

- Replacement parts

## Product Registration & Warranty

- [Oral-B Product Registration - Singapore (English)](https://www.service.oralb.com/sg/en/oral-b-electric-toothbrush-registration): Register Oral-B electric toothbrush for warranty and benefits
- [Product Registration - Croatia (Croatian)](https://www.service.oralb.com/hr/hr/registracija): Register Oral-B electric toothbrush for extended warranty
